source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: The Red Terror scores a **Critical Wound** whenever its unmodified **Wound roll** succeeds against a unit with **INFANTRY**, **MOUNTED** or **BEAST**. When one of the Red Terror’s attacks destroys a model with any of those keywords, the Red Terror heals D3+2 wounds at most per model killed.
